'''Gobi Glie's starship'''<ref name="Ship DB">{{Databank|gobi-glie-s-starship|Gobi Glie's Starship}}</ref> was a [[Rainhawk-class transport|''Rainhawk''-class transport]] belonging to the [[Twi'lek]] freedom fighter [[Gobi Glie]]. He used the [[starship]] to give the young [[Hera Syndulla]] [[pilot]]ing lessons, although he would not let her do takeoffs or landings. Glie also used the ship on supply runs for the [[Free Ryloth Movement]], including a rendezvous on [[Ryloth's third moon]] to pick up weapons. The [[transport]] was destroyed<ref name="Devil's Deal" /> around [[19 BBY]]<ref name="Date note" /> in an ambush by [[Galactic Empire]] forces, after which Glie, Syndulla, and [[Serin]] were arrested and charged with [[treason]] due to the smuggled weaponry.<ref name="Devil's Deal" />
